endpoints.name: GetPromptsAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all AI prompts with advanced filtering, pagination, and search capabilities. This endpoint supports comprehensive search criteria using a JSON array in the `request` body's `searchCriteria` field. Each criterion should specify a `field`, `operator`, and `value`. Refer to the entity's `searchMetadata` for a list of searchable fields, supported operators, and example criteria.

request.description: AI prompt filter request containing search and pagination parameters

example_uses: Find prompts containing 'email' in the name
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to search, list, filter, or browse AI prompts and prompt templates.

endpoints.name: GetPromptByIdAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific AI prompt by ID with complete details including prompt content, parameters, and configuration.
example_uses: Show me details for AI prompt ID 123
Show prompt with all parameters and content
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific AI prompt details by ID or when you need complete prompt information for editing or testing.

endpoints.name: CreatePromptAsync
endpoints.description: Creates a new AI prompt with complete configuration including content, parameters, model settings, and metadata.

model.description: AI prompt creation request with all configuration details

example_uses: Create a new email generation prompt
Add a customer service response template
Set up a new data analysis prompt
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to create, add, or set up a new AI prompt template.

endpoints.name: UpdatePromptAsync
endpoints.description: Updates an existing AI prompt's configuration including content, parameters, model settings, and metadata.
example_uses: Update prompt 123's content with new template
Change prompt 456's model from GPT-3.5 to GPT-4
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to update, modify, edit, or change AI prompt configuration or content.

endpoints.name: ExportAiPromptsAsync
endpoints.description: Exports all AI prompts as a C# seeder file for developers
example_uses: Download seeder file for AI prompts
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when developers need to export AI prompts as C# code for seeding or backup purposes.

endpoints.name: DeletePromptAsync
endpoints.description: Soft deletes an AI prompt from the system (marks as deleted rather than permanent removal).
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to delete, remove, or eliminate an AI prompt.

endpoints.name: GetPromptsByTypeAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all AI prompts filtered by specific prompt type with access control.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to filter prompts by specific type, category, or functional purpose.

endpoints.name: GetPromptTypesAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all unique prompt types available in the system for dropdown menus and filtering operations.
example_uses: Get prompt types for dropdown menu
What types of prompts are available?
Get filter options for prompt types
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user needs to see available prompt types for filtering or when building UI dropdown menus.

endpoints.name: GetModelsAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all unique AI models available in the system for dropdown menus and filtering operations.
example_uses: Get AI models for dropdown menu
Get filter options for AI models
List GPT and other model options
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user needs to see available AI models for filtering or when configuring prompt model settings.

endpoints.name: GetProjectsAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all unique projects associated with AI prompts for dropdown menus and filtering operations.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user needs to see available projects for filtering prompts or when assigning prompts to projects.

endpoints.name: GetLocationsAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all unique locations/regions associated with AI prompts, useful for populating dropdown menus and filtering operations within the system.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user needs to see available locations for filtering prompts or when assigning prompts to regions.

endpoints.name: TestPromptAsync
endpoints.description: Tests an AI prompt with provided test data to validate its effectiveness and output quality before deployment. Allows for specifying prompt details, test data, and model parameters.

Type.description: The type of prompt being tested.

Id.description: The ID of an existing prompt to test.

TestData.description: The input data to test the prompt against.

Model.description: The AI model to use for testing (e.g., 'gemini-pro').

Project.description: The project associated with the prompt.

Location.description: The geographical location for the AI model.

Temperature.description: Controls the randomness of the output. Lower values mean less random.

TopP.description: Controls diversity via nucleus sampling. Higher values consider more tokens.

MaxOutputTokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the output.

GoogleSearch.description: Indicates whether to enable Google Search for grounding the prompt.

SafetySettings.description: Safety settings to apply to the prompt generation.

Prompt.description: The actual prompt text to test.

example_uses: Test email prompt with sample data
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to test, validate, or preview AI prompt output before using it in production.

endpoints.name: UpgradeGeminiModel
endpoints.description: Initiates an upgrade process for all AI prompts to utilize the latest available Gemini model, ensuring optimal performance and access to new features.
example_uses: Upgrade all AI prompts to the latest Gemini model
Update AI models across the system
Ensure all prompts use the newest AI capabilities
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when a system-wide upgrade of AI models for all prompts is required.

endpoints.name: GetUserSessions
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all active or historical chat sessions for the current user with the Gemini AI assistant.
example_uses: Get my past conversations with the AI assistant
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to view their previous chat sessions with the AI assistant.

endpoints.name: GetSessionDetails
endpoints.description: Fetches the complete details and conversation history for a specific Gemini AI assistant session using its unique session ID.

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the Gemini chat session.

example_uses: Show conversation history for my last chat
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user needs to retrieve the full conversation and context of a particular AI assistant session.

endpoints.name: ChatWithGemini
endpoints.description: Sends a message to the Gemini AI assistant to initiate or continue a conversation, optionally including files, extracted text, or screen URLs for context.

Message.description: The user's message or query for the AI assistant.

sessionId.description: The ID of the current chat session to continue the conversation.

File.description: A single file to be sent to the AI assistant for analysis or context.

Files.description: A collection of files to be sent to the AI assistant.

ExtractedText.description: Text extracted from a document or source to provide context to the AI.

ScreenUrl.description: A URL pointing to a screen or web page for the AI to analyze.

State.description: Additional state information for the chat session.

example_uses: Chat with the AI about my project
Send a message to the AI assistant with this document
Continue our conversation about the budget report
Can you summarize this text for me?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to interact with the Gemini AI assistant, send a new message, or continue an existing chat session, potentially providing additional context like files or text.

endpoints.name: ProcessDataRelatedSummaryDetails
endpoints.description: Processes specific data related to a summary, identified by an ID and type, potentially using a message for additional context or instructions.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the data item to be processed.

Type.description: The type or category of the data item.

Message.description: An optional message providing context or instructions for processing.

example_uses: Analyze data of type 'report' with message 'urgent'
Process the financial data with ID 789
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when there is a need to process specific data points or summaries, requiring an ID and optionally a type and message for context.

endpoints.name: UpdateAiAssistantAccessibility
endpoints.description: Updates accessibility settings for a specific AI assistant session, such as enabling or disabling text-to-speech functionality.

SessionId.description: The unique identifier of the AI assistant session.

TextToSpeech.description: Boolean indicating whether text-to-speech should be enabled (true) or disabled (false).

example_uses: Enable text-to-speech for my current AI session
Turn off voice output for the assistant
Set text-to-speech to true for the AI chat
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to modify accessibility features, like text-to-speech, for their AI assistant sessions.

endpoints.name: UpdateSessionStar
endpoints.description: Marks or unmarks a specific AI assistant chat session as 'starred' for easy retrieval or categorization.

Starred.description: Boolean indicating whether the session should be starred (true) or unstarred (false).

SessionId.description: The unique identifier of the AI assistant session to update.

example_uses: Remove the star from my AI conversation
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to mark an AI assistant session as important or favorite, or to remove such a mark.

endpoints.name: UpdateSessionArchive
endpoints.description: Archives or unarchives a specific AI assistant chat session, moving it to or from an archived state.

Archived.description: Boolean indicating whether the session should be archived (true) or unarchived (false).

SessionId.description: The unique identifier of the AI assistant session to update.

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to archive an AI assistant session to hide it from the main view or to restore an previously archived session.

endpoints.name: UpdateSessionTitle
endpoints.description: Allows updating the title of an existing AI assistant session. This is useful for organizing and identifying specific conversations or tasks within the AI assistant.

req.description: Request body containing the new title and session ID.

example_uses: Update the title of my current AI chat session to 'Project Planning Discussion'.
Change the name of session 'abc-123' to 'Brainstorming for Q3 Report'.
I need to rename an AI assistant session after a conversation has concluded.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to assign or change a descriptive title for an AI assistant session, typically after a conversation has started or concluded, to improve organization and retrieval.

endpoints.name: GenerateAndStoreEmbeddings
endpoints.description: Triggers the process of generating and storing vector embeddings for a specified entity. This is crucial for enabling semantic search and similarity comparisons within the AI system.

entityName.description: The name of the entity for which to generate embeddings (e.g., 'documents', 'users').

example_uses: Generate embeddings for all new policy documents.
Trigger the embedding process for the 'knowledge base' entity.
I need to update the semantic search index by generating new embeddings for a specific data set.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to initiate the creation of numerical representations (embeddings) for data, which are then used by AI models for tasks like similarity search, recommendation, or context retrieval. This is typically an administrative or background task.

endpoints.name: GenerateTitle
endpoints.description: Requests the AI assistant to automatically generate a concise and relevant title for a given session based on its content. This helps in quickly summarizing and identifying sessions.

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the AI assistant session for which to generate a title.

example_uses: Ask the AI to suggest a title for my current chat.
Generate a summary title for session 'xyz-456'.
I want the AI to automatically name this conversation.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you want the AI to automatically create a descriptive title for an ongoing or completed AI assistant session, saving manual effort and improving session discoverability.

endpoints.name: GenerateSuggestions
endpoints.description: Prompts the AI assistant to generate contextually relevant suggestions, which could include follow-up questions, related topics, or next steps.
example_uses: Ask the AI for some follow-up questions based on our discussion.
Generate suggestions for next steps in this project.
I need the AI to provide some ideas for related topics.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need the AI to provide proactive assistance, such as suggesting relevant actions, questions, or content based on the current context or conversation.
